brief:
An Israeli organization promoting West Bank settlements, Shivat Zion, faces a police report following allegations it threatened the Palestinian rector of Glasgow University, Middle East Eye reported. The group was touring the United Kingdom at the time of the incident.

Details of the specific threat and the circumstances surrounding the report remain unclear. Shivat Zion describes itself as an advocacy group for Israeli settlers in occupied Palestinian territory.
dek: Israeli group promoting illegal settlements touring UK reported to police over 'threat' Submitted by Imran Mulla on Fri, 11/27/2026 - 11:02 Shivat Zion, which promotes West Bank settlements, allegedly threatened Palestinian rector of Glasgow University…
title: UK police receive report against Israeli settlement advocacy group
